title: Delegation as its own plugin and the monolith retired
summary: Stage 3 of the plugin split, after orchestration: moves the delegation edict, profiles, gate, pi extension and model plan into the steward-delegation plugin, then deletes the old single plugin and turns the root README into an index of the plugins.
motivation: Steward 0.14.2 is one 1,638-line hook script doing four jobs for four harnesses, so a user cannot take one part, one switch turns off two gates, and personal text ships to everyone (docs/roadmap/plugin-split.md, Why).

included: Shape: a set of three binders, because the operator asked for small separate binders (test 1): steward-prose-gate, then steward-orchestration (after: steward-prose-gate), then this one (after: steward-orchestration). Each validates and leaves the suite green on its own.

Design steps 9-12, 14 and 16-20 of docs/roadmap/plugin-split.md 'Build sequence', which is the source of truth for every file, contract and done-check. Steps 12, 14, 16 and 18 are each split in two so every commit stays green: 12 into model-plan-move and model-plan-pi-branch; 14 into pi-extension-prose-cut and then pi-extension-move (in the stated order the moved extension would send prose-gate calls to delegation_hook.py, which has no prose-gate mode, and the prose cases would go red); 16 into edicts-claude-pi (which changes all four profile-body copies, because the parity tests compare them) and edicts-copilot-codex; 18 into retire-old-tests and then retire-monolith.

Branch: hatch builds from plugin-split (local git config hatch.defaultBranch=plugin-split). Before this binder's delivery starts, the operator has merged the steward-prose-gate and steward-orchestration integration branches into plugin-split, so plugins/steward-prose-gate/**, plugins/steward-orchestration/**, their scripts.test segments, their catalog entries, the extended tests/test_catalogs.py and the moved onboarding template exist at the base.

New plugin folder plugins/steward-delegation/; content moves use git mv so history is kept. Outside plugins/ this binder edits package.json, the two root catalogs, root tests that point at moved files, the monolith files it repoints and later deletes, README.md and three history docs under docs/roadmap/.

Adaptations to the design's step list, each needed to keep a commit green: model-plan-move moves only the four modules and repoints the root tests; the 13 model-plan and stats test files move with the pi branch in model-plan-pi-branch. The doc- and README-reading model-plan cases stay in a root file, tests/test_model_plan_docs.py, because plugin tests read only their own folder. Hook-level pi tests from tests/test_pi_harness.py are ported in model-plan-pi-branch, where the pi branch lands; profile and skill tests in pi-extension-move, with the package-manifest tests going to a root tests/test_pi_package.py. pi-extension-prose-cut also adds the prose-gate extension to the root package's pi extensions. edicts-copilot-codex deletes the two root CopilotSkillTests cases that read `steward:<role>` rows. retire-monolith rewords README.md:109 and :133, so the design's step 18 grep passes with no README exclusion.

Accepted transitional state: the root .claude-plugin/plugin.json is not repointed after delegation-content-move, so until retire-monolith a `claude --plugin-dir .` session of this tree loads the old hooks without the seven agents. Nobody installs the root: both catalogs pin v0.14.2.

Item check for every item: `PI_SUBAGENTS_DIR=/nonexistent npm test` from the repo root, expect 'fail 0'. npm test runs package.json scripts.test; at this binder's base it is `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests && python3 -m unittest discover -s plugins/steward-prose-gate/tests && python3 -m unittest discover -s plugins/steward-orchestration/tests && node --test 'tests/pi/*.test.mjs' 'plugins/*/tests/pi/*.test.mjs'`, and after pi-extension-move it is the design's final form: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests && python3 -m unittest discover -s plugins/steward-delegation/tests && python3 -m unittest discover -s plugins/steward-prose-gate/tests && python3 -m unittest discover -s plugins/steward-orchestration/tests && node --test 'plugins/*/tests/pi/*.test.mjs'`. node stays the last segment joined by &&, so its 'fail 0' line prints only when every unittest run before it passed.

Known machine mismatch, not caused by the split: PI_SUBAGENTS_DIR=/nonexistent skips the 13 tests that need an installed pi-subagents.
